meta.name: Arête
meta.author: Sunnyside
meta.essence: Alpine cartography · every layer is a cut
meta.promise: Guided ridge traverses and hand-cut topographic editions, made from two papers: ivory cartridge stock and one ultramarine impression. Type is set on the range itself, depth comes from five named paper surfaces, and the contrast ledger prints the three pairs it fails.
meta.family: Two stacked ridge sheets — a floating ribbon over a grounded mass — separated by one 5-unit seam.
meta.oneSentence: Arête is an alpine cartography atelier whose surfaces are stacked paper cuts: ivory stock, ultramarine ink, knife-cut edges and 5-unit seams instead of gradients.

theme.family: constructed — Kuwayama parametric vector discipline, cut-paper material bias
theme.material: ivory cartridge stock, tracing vellum, deckle edges, ultramarine ink, graphite annotation
theme.edge: knife-cut — 0px outer / 2px inner, 2px rules, hard 4px paper-shadow offsets
theme.stroke: zero line icons; filled geometric vectors only, 5-unit seams as the single detail cut
theme.tile: editorial cartography — 66ch reading measure, route ledgers, tabular elevation data
theme.density: editorial balanced (96px section rhythm, 24px cell padding, 1.62 leading)
theme.fieldRecipe: torn-paper alpine collage — ivory stock, white paper peaks, a grey and a black layer, one cobalt seam, visible fibre
theme.markForm: a floating ridge ribbon (10u thick) over a grounded mass, parted by one 5u seam on a 64-unit sheet

surfaces.name: Cut sheet
surfaces.rule: Flat stock, 2u seams, no shadow. The base layer.
surfaces.when: Long reading sections and token tables.

surfaces.name: Lifted layer
surfaces.rule: 4px hard offset shadow, zero blur. One sheet above another.
surfaces.when: Cards, plates and anything that must read as stacked paper.

surfaces.name: Vellum overlay
surfaces.rule: 88% ivory tint, 18px fiber blur, deckle hairline.
surfaces.when: Type over artwork, route profiles, the refraction stage.

surfaces.name: Deckle edge
surfaces.rule: Generated rough edge from one turbulence mask, used once per composition.
surfaces.when: Section dividers and the closing poster only.

scale.sample: The ridge is a line the mountain draws.
Two papers, one cut, and the altitude between.
Ivory above the tree line, ultramarine in the valley, and a knife that never wobbles.
Four traverses leave from the same hut. Each map is cut in seven sheets and registered by hand, so no two editions share a seam.
